title: Look at the sign
text: $$t^2$$ is never negative, so $$y'$$ has the same sign as $$\sin{y}$$ whenever $$t$$ is not $$0$$.

title: Test values near the equilibrium
text: Just below it, $$sin\left(y\right)>0$$ so $$y$$ increases toward it. Just above it, $$sin\left(y\right)<0$$ so $$y$$ decreases toward it. So it is stable.
